stories.title: ICE responds after pregnant woman alleges pepper spray and force during Modesto protest
stories.summary: ICE is responding to a pregnant woman’s claim she was pepper-sprayed and thrown to the ground at a protest outside the Stanislaus County Jail in Modesto.
